transcript.text: my samsung washer dryer is making evrything smell damp/musty even after its washed, its gross. wot do i do

That musty smell is usually caused by trapped moisture or lint not being fully removed during the drying phase. The most common culprit is a blocked pump filter or condenser, which stops hot air circulating properly and leaves damp fluff inside. Please start with these owner-safe checks:
1. Check the load size: Washer-dryers can only dry about half the weight they wash (e.g., an 8kg wash might only be a 5kg dry). If you put a full load straight onto dry, it will likely remain damp and smell.
2. Clean the filter and condenser: Unplug the machine, open the bottom front panel, and clean the pump filter and any condenser unit thoroughly. Fluff buildup here is a frequent cause of poor drying and odours. Once you've done that, run an empty hot wash cycle with some vinegar or washing machine cleaner to freshen up the drum and door seal.
ok i opened the bottom flap and the filter had smelly sludge and fluff in it, yuck. not sure about the load size thing tho. should i still do the hot wash with vinegar?

Yes, please do run that empty hot wash with vinegar or a dedicated washing machine cleaner to freshen up the drum and door seal. To make sure we target any specific issues for your Samsung model (like condenser cleaning steps), could you tell me the exact model number? It’s usually on a sticker inside the door rim or on the back of the door.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
the model number is WD80T554DBW. ok will do the hot wash with vinegar, anything else i should do?

Yes, please go ahead with that hot wash cycle—it will help kill off any bacteria left behind. To stop the smell from coming back, you also need to wipe out the rubber door seal folds with a damp cloth (pull them back gently) and clean the detergent drawer if your model has one. Does your WD80T554DBW have a removable detergent drawer?
yeah it has a drawer that pulls out i think. theres black slimy stuff in the softener bit when i looked, ew. how do i clean it?

To clean the detergent drawer properly: pull it all the way out until it stops (there is usually a release tab or button you press to lift it free). Soak the plastic parts in warm water with a little washing-up liquid and use an old toothbrush to scrub away that black slimy residue from every corner. Once they are clean, wipe the empty slot inside the machine with a damp cloth before sliding the drawer back in. Since your filter was also sludgy, this suggests it is just a hygiene issue—run that hot maintenance wash you planned and leave the door open between uses to let it dry out.
